text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down slightly over 24 hours while the Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory, suggesting market participants remain broadly confident despite the minor pullback. Bitcoin's dominance at 59.6% indicates the largest cap asset is holding its relative strength, though the modest $69B total volume hints that conviction isn't translating into aggressive buying. The seven-day decline in sentiment momentum combined with flat-to-negative movement across major pairs points to a consolidation phase rather than panic or momentum.
